info.title: Kaladel.Kiota.ImportExtensionFix.TypeScript
info.description:
Post-processes Kiota-generated TypeScript clients to strip the unnecessary ".js"
            extensions (and redundant "/index" segments) that Kiota adds to relative import/export
            specifiers, which can otherwise confuse IDE type resolution for the generated ".ts"
            files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Strips unnecessary '.js' extensions (and redundant '/index' segments) from relative import/export specifiers in Kiota-generated TypeScript files.

options.name: --kiota-output
options.description: Path to the directory Kiota generated the TypeScript client into. All '.ts' files in this directory (recursively) are scanned.
